name: JellyXR
description: X-Ray style cast cards on pause (Android TV friendly).
overview: Scans videos once with on-server face recognition to learn which cast members appear when. Pause on Android TV and JellyXR sends text cards with the actors on screen (this scene) or the whole episode cast.
changelog: 1.4.0.0: Support for the JellyXR TV companion app for Android TV: with the app installed on the box, pausing shows a panel with cast portraits over the Jellyfin player instead of 2-line toasts (new setting "JellyXR TV app: on pause show the portraits panel", on by default). Devices without the app still get text messages.
